note: SHA-256 of each asset this build expects, verified before the file is opened; a mismatch is an error, not a warning. Models are identified by file bytes. Atlases are identified by an ordered hash of their rows, because SQLite rewrites page metadata on open and the file hash changes after a mere read. 'url' is null until the assets are published alongside the tagged release. A download is verified against sha256 where the manifest records one and against content_fingerprint where it does not (atlases); an asset with neither is refused rather than installed unverified.
